changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user".hesap_score ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_in TEXT NOT NULL, -- PINFL/STIR (barqaror kalit) score INT, -- 0..1000 band TEXT, -- A+/A/B/C/D/F | INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY confidence NUMERIC, -- coverage'dan (0..1) coverage NUMERIC, -- mavjud sub-skorlar og'irlik ulushi insufficient_history BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, cold_start BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, sub_scores TEXT, -- {S1..S5, og'irliklar} JSON inputs_snapshot TEXT, -- xom counterlar JSON (explainability + ML) reason_codes TEXT, -- barqaror driver enum'lar JSON massiv computed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_hesap_score_user_in ON "user".hesap_score (user_in); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hesap_score_band ON "user".hesap_score (band);
